hypothesis: A fixed hetero-GNN Feasible-Pair Pointer improves final verifier coverage over the matched fixed hetero-GNN static decoder on untouched continuous-process allocation groups.

benchmark.cell_generator_parameters: identical to a3_5_pointer_pilot_v1 except for split, master seed, ID namespace and group counts
benchmark.generation_authorisation: requires implementation and evaluator source seal; this preregistration alone does not execute generation

primary_analysis.group_value: mean binary verified outcome across two variants and three matched model-seed pairs
primary_analysis.estimand: unweighted mean paired coverage difference across 72 task groups
primary_analysis.test: one-sided paired sign-flip randomization test over task-group differences
primary_analysis.confidence_interval: two-sided 95% task-group cluster bootstrap percentile interval
success_requires: zero integrity, hash, leakage, mask and atomicity failure
mean paired coverage difference greater than zero
95% cluster-bootstrap lower confidence bound greater than zero
at least two of three seed-wise paired coverage differences greater than zero
primary_analysis.multiple_testing: no cell-wise hypothesis determines the primary result

secondary_analysis.cell_coverage: report all six cells with group-clustered intervals; descriptive
secondary_analysis.strong_baseline_comparisons: paired group-level coverage differences and 95% cluster-bootstrap intervals
secondary_analysis.noninferiority_interpretation: one overall frozen group out of 72; secondary only
secondary_analysis.runtime_protocol: single CPU thread on one recorded node class; model load excluded, encoding/decoding/scheduling/verifying included; no test-time warm-up or adaptation
secondary_analysis.teacher_forced_pair_accuracy: report pilot value only as training diagnostic; it is not available or required on sealed instances

result_classes.A3_5_DECODER_HYPOTHESIS_NOT_SUPPORTED: valid run but the preregistered primary test fails
result_classes.A3_5_DECODER_HYPOTHESIS_SUPPORTED_HETERO: primary test passes but the robustness flag fails
result_classes.A3_5_DECODER_HYPOTHESIS_SUPPORTED: primary test and robustness flag pass
result_classes.A3_5_STRONG_BASELINE_ADVANTAGE: decoder hypothesis is supported and the secondary lower confidence bound exceeds every strong baseline

claim_boundaries: The primary paper hypothesis concerns Pair-Pointer versus the matched static decoder, not superiority over CP-SAT/MILP/LNS.
Training labels are heterogeneous solver-generated verified incumbents, not LNS expert solutions, global optima or real expert actions.
Teacher-forced sequence accuracy is not the primary outcome because multiple verified action serializations may exist.
All evidence is SIM_GEOMETRIC and does not establish real deployment, collision safety, sim-to-real transfer or physical-process quality.
A3 v4 remains failed and immutable; A4 remains closed until this one-time evaluation is complete.
